title: Level 4 (Expert) - C-16
notes:
West leads the ♠4 against 3NT. West's lead is won with the ♠A. There are 6 top tricks (2 spades, 2 hearts, and 2 clubs). If diamonds are no worse than 4-2, it will be possible to develop 3 extra tricks in diamonds.

If South leads a top diamond at trick 2 (or crosses to dummy and leads a diamond), he will be allowed to win the trick. If diamonds are 4-2, South will lack the hand entries to establish and cash 3 diamond tricks.

South can ensure the contract when diamonds are no worse than 4-2 by ducking a diamond trick immediately. If the defense switches to hearts, South must take care to win this trick in the dummy. Diamonds are continued, eventually forcing out the ♦A. South still has a hand entry in the ♥K to cash the long diamonds. North has entries in clubs to cash the ♠K.
